verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage is a SaaS compliance platform that processes customer data and runs AI agents for screening and transaction monitoring, so an opt-out from AI model training is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents screening, cases, exports, webhooks and agentic workflows, but nothing about training-data use, an opt-out control, or contractual no-training commitments. The Starter Plan note about agent configurations covers agent customization, not training data, so it does not count here.
